name: Birmingham City University
description:

A university that cares about shaping the futures of young people for the betterment of the individual and society?

Birmingham City University has been ranked fourth among all English universities in the English Social Mobility Index.

441 courses are on offer at Birmingham City University! Many courses have internationally recognised accreditations: ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants), CIMA (Chartered Institute of Management Accountants) and RIBA (Royal Institute of British Architects).

Birmingham City University has links to companies such as Microsoft, Cisco, Jaguar Land Rover, Sky UK and the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra.

Birmingham City University has an array of impressive stats! 

  • 93% of its research was recognised internationally for originality, significance and rigour

Are you concerned about choosing a university that will pave the way for a successful future? Unsure if some universities might not offer the exact programs that match your goals? Trying to figure out how to balance personal satisfaction with career achievement?

Discover why Birmingham City University might just be the place for you!

Birmingham City University was originally founded as the Birmingham College of Art back in 1843. In 1971 it was designated as a polytechnic and in 1992 it received university status. Birmingham is home to amazing architecture, art, music, theater and sport venues, an excellent nightlife, great shopping and dining including the world-famous Bullring Centre. It also benefits from brilliant transport links with the rest of the UK and Europe.

Student Life

Birmingham City University encourages students to take pride in their work and to plan for their future. There is a wealth of student support, including the Centre for Academic Success and Student Mentoring Programmes, in addition to professional health and wellbeing services. The hundreds of student societies include faith clubs that celebrate all different cultures.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Birmingham City University has multiple halls of residence throughout the city. Most residence halls are within a 10-minute walk of the city centre and close to the university campus. The majority of university housing is ensuite, with laundry facilities, shared social spaces and often a gym contained within the flats.

The University provides an accommodation guide for students. You can choose to stay in homestay arrangements. These are arranged separately by the university.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Sports
You can take advantage of several sports facilities across Birmingham for free or at reduced membership fees. You can take part in various sports like badminton, netball, basketball, cricket, and volleyball. There are also strength areas, workout studios and all-weather pitches.

Laboratory
There are multiple facilities including the CAD and Programming Labs, Electronics Lab, Civil and Bio-Engineering Labs, Zeiss Laboratory, and many more.
